description: Split a PDF by 1-based page ranges (one output file per comma group, e.g. "1-3,5"), or extract specific pages into a single PDF (e.g. "1,3,5"). Provide exactly one of `ranges` or `pages`. Runs entirely on this machine — the file is read and written locally and never sent anywhere.

force.description: Replace the output file if it already exists (default: refuse, so existing files are never silently clobbered)

output.description: Output path. In range mode with >1 group, files get -1, -2, … suffixes.

pages.description: 1-based pages for a single combined output, e.g. "1,3,5"

ranges.description: 1-based ranges, one output per comma group, e.g. "1-3,5,7-9"

name: pdf_split
title: Split / extract PDF pages
